```yaml
name: Benchmark

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  fmt:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-rust@v1
        with:
          rust-version: stable
      - name: cargo fmt
        run: cargo fmt --check

  clippy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: fmt
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-rust@v1
        with:
          rust-version: stable
      - uses: actions/cache@v3
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            target
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-
      - name: cargo clippy
        run: cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings

  test-lib:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: clippy
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-rust@v1
        with:
          rust-version: stable
      - uses: actions/cache@v3
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            target
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-
      - name: cargo test lib
        run: cargo test --lib

  test-all:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: test-lib
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-rust@v1
        with:
          rust-version: stable
      - uses: actions/cache@v3
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            target
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-
      - name: cargo test all
        run: cargo test --all

  build-release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: test-all
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-rust@v1
        with:
          rust-version: stable
      - uses: actions/cache@v3
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            target
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-
      - name: cargo build release
        run: cargo build --release

  benchmark:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build-release
    env:
      ACCURACY_THRESHOLD: 0.90
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-rust@v1
        with:
          rust-version: stable
      - uses: actions/cache@v3
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            target
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-
      - name: Run benchmark
        run: |
          cargo run --release -- --benchmark benchmark_corpus.json > benchmark_output.txt
          echo "Benchmark output:" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          cat benchmark_output.txt >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          # Extract accuracy from output
          ACCURACY=$(grep -Eo 'Accuracy:[[:space:]]*[0-9]*\.[0-9]+' benchmark_output.txt | awk '{print $2}')
          echo "Detected accuracy: $ACCURACY"
          THRESHOLD=${ACCURACY_THRESHOLD}
          # Compare
          awk -v acc="$ACCURACY" -v th="$THRESHOLD" 'BEGIN{if(acc+0 < th+0){print "Accuracy below threshold (" acc " < " th ")"; exit 1} else {print "Accuracy meets threshold (" acc " >= " th ")"; exit 0}}'
```
